title: Shangri-La Frontier
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Rakuro Hizutome, a high schooler who loves beating badly made 'trash games', tries the hugely popular full-dive VR game Shangri-La Frontier as the bird-masked Sunraku (to verify). With his rabbit companion Emul and gamer friends Pencilgon and Oikatzo, he takes on the game's Unique Monsters, such as Wethermon, and uncovers its hidden lore (to verify).
life_message: It holds up mastery through persistence, fair play and the joy of a hard challenge shared with friends.
